cross_disciplinary_pairing.discipline: deterministic merchant analytics and local-language LLM guidance
cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Nader combines deterministic merchant analytics with a local GGUF language model: verified revenue, order, traffic, and inventory facts are passed into the offline prompt so each operational recommendation is grounded in local business evidence when connectivity is unavailable.

test_prompts.prompt: I run a small grocery shop in Morocco. A popular product has stopped selling and I have too much stock. Give me a practical three-step plan to reduce the stock without harming customer trust.

Je gère une petite boutique de vêtements avec un budget marketing très limité. Proposez un plan simple sur sept jours pour attirer davantage de clients locaux, avec des actions que je peux suivre moi-même.
